update: Building Evaluation Probes into Agentic AI
impact: Official deep-research testbed evaluates every source chunk and citation against strict rubrics and stores a structured audit trail; directly applicable to evidence-chain agents.

update: Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR Implementation Guide ballot 2
impact: Defines machine-interpretable Evidence, Citation and ArtifactAssessment profiles, including certainty of evidence, risk of bias and recommendation justification.
Uses long narrative queries and evaluates relevance, completeness, attribution verification and agreement; participating systems expose sentence-support metrics and hierarchical citations.

update: Draft lifecycle guidance for AI-enabled medical devices
impact: Emphasizes transparency, bias controls, documentation and performance monitoring across the total product lifecycle; useful as a governance baseline if the prototype approaches clinical use.

update: Ethics and governance guidance for large multi-modal models in health
impact: Calls for well-defined tasks, transparent design, stakeholder participation, independent post-release auditing and published impact assessments.
Treats confabulated facts, logic and citations as consequential risks and provides lifecycle risk-management actions.

update: Transparency principles for machine-learning-enabled medical devices
impact: Frames transparency around audience, purpose, content, placement, timing and medium, with emphasis on human-AI team performance and known information gaps.

update: Living GRADE Book and decision-threshold guidance
impact: Operationalizes certainty assessment across risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision and dissemination bias, linked to decision thresholds.
Provides a transparent search-screen-include-exclude flow model that can be adapted to show how an agent assembled an evidence set.
Defines interoperable Entity, Activity and Agent provenance chains with derivation, usage, generation and attribution relations.
